The ten 2->2 to 2->4 rows were timed twice: round 1 (08:55-09:02 UTC, load average 330-371, against 140-230 in milestone m1026a) measured up to 29 % above m1026a while the same-core paired A/B of the two engines measured new/old ratios of 0.95-1.16 (median 1.02, 19 configuration/B pairs), i.e. host contention; round 2 (09:21-09:27 UTC, load average 158-172), the same jobs once more for every one of these rows, decides whatever it gave (its records are listed after round 1's, which stay earlier_runs); by the same rule u u~ > e- e+ g g g LC, whose round-1 generate stage (34.5 s at 09:19 UTC, against 26.5 s in m1026a) contradicted the same-core A/B (old 26.3 s, new 15.8 s), was run once more at 09:43 UTC (generate 15.0 s; decides)
integrated_configuration: native per-point inputs on slice 28a16255 (loop 8335e9e8 with ew-ct, ew-epsilon, fail-closed, sdk-parity, ew-leptons, identical-flavour-lc and gate-b128): the stored plan v4 with point_inputs native-v2 and the companion of the certified-scaleless families (binary64 SymJIT plane applications stored as IR and recompiled at load; Runtime.load regenerates nothing), schedule B, 16 lanes; timed through NativeExecutor(slice, inputs=native).evaluate on the exact stream points (the public artifact's plan digest and bitwise the same binary64 values as the loaded artifact's executor at all 128 points of u u~ > d d~ g: public_path_check), on a frozen setup heap (timing_protocol); g g > g g g g g from its stored process (pyamplicol --store --generate-only, then --load: the loop runtime member with native point inputs, nothing regenerated)
timing_protocol: binary64, finite part only (poles none), no stability check, one thread on one pinned core (taskset, RAYON_NUM_THREADS=1, threads=1), warm-up excluded, the setup heap frozen out of Python's cyclic collector before the warm-up by the committed harness itself (gc.collect + gc.freeze, Run.freeze_heap of tools/loop_benchmark/pyamplicol_v2.py since de8d3eb8, integrated with 46f72f20; no scratch launcher: the checkout 28a16255 is unmodified). 2->2 to 2->4: paired blocks of B = 1 (24 blocks) and B = 128 (3 blocks) in full colour, leading colour at B = 128 (3 blocks), 3 rounds. 2->5: full and leading colour at B = 16 and 128, 3 paired rounds after a 16-point warm-up per B, with the physical rows (every pole at stream points 0-2) and, in full colour, the stability rows after the timing. known_limitations: G1's rows: none of the known limitations of 28a16255 applies to a G1 row. The identical-flavour LC/NLC limitation of milestone m1026a is removed (identical-flavour-lc: exact LC and NLC of identical-flavour quark lines, the loop-request blocks and the counterterm program split by U(1)-subtraction N_c grade): G1's u u~ > u u~ g native/lc is a validated value, no longer a cost measurement only (its binary64 values differ from m1026a's grade-0 projections at every point, as they must; full colour bitwise). Limitations of the engine that G1's rows do not reach (all QCD corrections on loop_sm in GeV, quark masses 0 or the top mass): photon-only QED corrections on loop_qcd_qed_sm (vetoes reaching counterterms with empty or nominal loop labels) are refused (veto-unlabelled-counterterms; full EW corrections on the same model work); in the fast binary64 loop lanes masses below 1e-9 in the model's units are treated as massless, Ninja's light-like spinors are off by up to about 1e-5 for legs near the -z axis, and models whose units are about 1e4 or more away from GeV can give silent O(10 %) errors with stability checks off (the generic binary64 engine and double-double are exact in all three cases and the rotation / reduction-direction checks flag them; G1 times with checks off; its accuracy checks are m1026a's, with identical max errors, and the only deviations above a fixture tolerance are at binary64-unstable points that the estimate flags: g g > g g g g point 1, 2.4e-7, estimate 3.0e-6, DoubleFloat 7.1e-11 (milestone.json), and g g > g g g g g points 4 and 8 (validation_decisions)); still refused EW requests: charged Goldstone mixing reached only by g b > t t~ b, ghost vertices not closed under conjugation, u d~ > t b~ EW, Goldstone mixing at a massive leg (EWI-7), complex-mass scheme (EWI-10).
